prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1486; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the reported distal radius injury. Radiographs and examination findings support a wrist fracture, with localized tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side, while neurovascular testing and the remaining range-of-motion checks were within normal limits. Over six visits, care followed a standard course of immobilization, pain management, and progressive therapy exercises. Visit frequency decreased as symptoms improved and function returned. The record also notes prior treatment to the same body region within the past two years, and that earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints. Billed services correspond to the visits documented, with no repeated charges identified. Patient is expected to continue home exercises and return for reassessment if symptoms change.
